{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tug module''' was used by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] construction dock workers to move finished [[Starship/Legends|starships]] into open space. Magnetically clamped to the bridge of the new ship and lacking any thruster [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of their own, tug modules were designed to use the engines of the ship that it was moving.

Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Ott Klemp]] and the [[Scavenger Squadron]] used tug modules in an attempt to save completed [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] from [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat's]] final explosive plan for [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]].
